$comment: Career-guidance topic classifier keywords. Matching is case-insensitive, whole-word (an optional plural s is allowed); spaces match spaces or hyphens. Score = sum over matched keywords of the weight of each field it appears in. An event is career-guidance when score >= minScore. Edit this file, not code. List a word once: a plural s is matched automatically, and multi-word phrases that only repeat single keywords add nothing. Ambiguous words are left out on purpose: bare SOP (a standard operating procedure in most workplaces) and campus (campus security). SOP is matched only through the phrase statement of purpose, or by an admission/university/college/abroad word in the same title.
